text: In this unit Alex travels to Munich with Max, and the delayed train, a complaint and the hotel test their German. In this unit you will buy tickets, find your platform, check in at an airport or a hotel, book a campsite and a bed in a hostel, and deal with problems such as a delay, a lost bag or a broken shower. At the end of the grammar section there is a short check of units 6 to 11. The scenes are set in places you may know: a ticket counter, a platform, a train, an airport, a hotel, a campsite and a lost property office.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
